mechanism_narrative: A decline in the federal funds rate below 0.2% signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces discount rates for equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 0.2% over any 5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 0.25% and rises by more than 0.1 percentage points monthly, it signals monetary tightening that increases equity discount rates, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 45% of triggered periods (FEDFUNDS > 0.25% and monthly change > 0.1pp) over any 5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate deteriorating consumer demand, reducing corporate revenue expectations and driving negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS are below their 3-month moving averages.

mechanism_narrative: In high unemployment regimes (UNRATE > 8.5%), a decline in unemployment rate by more than 0.1 percentage points signals improving labor market conditions that boost consumer spending and corporate earnings, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when UNRATE is above 8.5% and declines by more than 0.1pp.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in industrial production (INDPRO) above 95.0 indicates robust manufacturing activity that supports corporate profit growth, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO is above 95.0 over any 5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) fall below 550.0 thousand units, it signals housing sector weakness that reduces consumer confidence and corporate investment, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 45% of periods when HOUST is below 550.0.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in inflation (CPIAUCSL) and the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signal aggressive monetary policy to combat inflation, increasing real interest rates and compressing equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when both CPIAUCSL and FEDFUNDS are above their 3-month moving averages.

mechanism_narrative: In early-cycle expansion (GDPC1 annualized growth > 2.0%), a rise in retail sales (RSAFS) above 0.5% signals strengthening consumer demand that boosts corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when RSAFS rises by more than 0.5% and GDPC1 annualized growth exceeds 2.0%.
